parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the application name on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page of the ApsaraVideo Live console.

parameters.name: Delay
parameters.description: The time period after which the SEI is inserted after the request is received. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Pattern
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to append the SEI to each keyframe or frame. Valid values:

*   **keyframe**
*   **frame**

parameters.name: Repeat
parameters.description: The number of times that the SEI is repeatedly inserted. A value of -1 specifies infinite times.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description:
The name of the live stream.

>  The value of this parameter must be the name of the source stream. This way, the SEI is inserted to all the transcoded streams.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The SEI text. It can be up to 4,000 bytes in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live add-trancode-sei --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --text liveSei0000 --pattern keyframe --repeat -1 --delay 100 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live AddTrancodeSEI --region cn-hangzhou --Pattern keyframe --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --Text liveSei0000 --Repeat '-1' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Delay 100 --AppName liveApp0000
